svg.text: AtmosMesh Spot, first unit (In/Out + probe) — 14 × 20 holes, component-side view, USB overhanging row 1
One 3.3 V domain. Pin names photo-verified 2026-09-04; row spacing 7 pitches, dry-fit confirmed. Header positions exact; passives by row. Wiring by pin name is authoritative.

red = keep-out (module end with buttons and antenna)
black = female header pin · grey block = 5.08 mm terminal pole
